description: Lists the remote MCP servers hosted on mcp.wondel.ai: what each is for, its category, latency, status and tool names. Use it to pick the right server for a task, then connect to `endpoint` with any MCP client (Streamable HTTP, no auth). Filter by `category`, or by `query`, a case-insensitive text match over server title, summary and tool names.

category.description: Only servers in this routing category.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against server title, summary and tool names.

name: list_servers
title: List MCP servers
